venue: PlayLive Melbourne, 129 York St, South Melbourne VIC 3205
notes: Featured rows are the $2,500 Main Event ($1M GTD): Day 1 flights A and Q (23 Jan), B (30 Jan), C (3 Feb), D (4 Feb) and E (5 Feb); Day 2 flights A and Q (24 Jan), B (31 Jan), C (4 Feb), D (5 Feb) and E (6 Feb), each priced and taking entries to the time shown; Day 3 (7 Feb), Day 4 to the final 36 (8 Feb) and Day 5, the final table (9 Feb). The poster prints the Q flights as Day 1Q* and Day 2Q*.

Buy-in shown as total, then entry + fee. A satellite's guarantee is the number of seats it pays (seats_guaranteed); the BIG10@PlayLive satellite pays packages (packages_guaranteed). The poster's footnote: the BIG10 package includes entry to the Opening Event, Main Event, Mega Mystery Bounty, The Wildcard, Melbourne Poker Open, Mini Main Event, Super Six Hundy, Deep Freeze, The Closer and Berserker, valued at $11,500.

rego_ends_time is the late-registration clock time the poster prints, "Day 2" where registration runs to the start of Day 2, or empty for a final day. Where the poster prints FT or F-36 in that column instead, plays_to records it (final table, final 36). The poster prints no late-rego level, shot clock, re-entry column or room.
A Day 2+ row with no buy-in is qualifiers only (buy_in null). The three noon mixed-game events (PLO Hi/Lo, NL 2-7 Single Draw, Big O) print no guarantee.
live_stream marks the rows the poster tags LIVE. 26 January is printed AUS DAY.
The poster's "Mega Mystery Bouny - Day - 1D" on 27 January is recorded as Mega Mystery Bounty – Day 1D.
